description: This file defines the PimReport class which implements EndpointAwareReport interface and provides functionalities for generating, validating, and managing reports related to the PIM module in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving report headers, filters, data, and handling report accessibility permissions.

classes.name: PimReport
classes.description: Class responsible for handling PIM report generation, header/filter definitions, data retrieval, filter parameter preparation, validation, and access control within the OrangeHRM PIM module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the report with a specific report ID.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the ReportGeneratorService instance used to generate reports.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Returns the header definition for the report based on its ID.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns a new Filter object to define report filters.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves report data based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares and returns filter parameters from the endpoint request context.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the request parameters, mainly sorting and pagination.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks if the report is accessible based on the report name parameter and throws exception if not authorized.
